rows.title: Ask who will use it and why
rows.done_when: You can say what it is for in one sentence

rows.title: Decide the border between inputs and outputs
rows.done_when: What comes in and what goes out is on a list

rows.title: Decide how the data is kept
rows.done_when: Every item to be saved is written down

rows.title: Make the input screen and saving
rows.done_when: Enter one record, reopen the app, and it is still there

rows.title: Make the total chart
rows.done_when: The monthly totals show as a chart

rows.title: Screen for phones
rows.done_when: Input and totals work on a phone
rows.note: First make it work on the user's own computer. Waiting for the user to decide.

rows.title: Run it by hand and check
rows.done_when: The user entered one week of records and could use it
